meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: Claude 会组建一个 5 人安全团队(3 名漏洞猎人、2 名 PoC 工程师),并行审计你的代码,验证哪些漏洞真的可利用,并输出带严重性、修复建议和残余风险的报告。
howto.when: 当你说出 'security-research'、'security review' 等关键词,或使用 `/security-research` 命令时触发;技能要求处于团队模式、主会话中,并会确定一个具体审计目标(未提供时默认当前仓库)。

say.text: 对我的代码仓库做一次安全审查。
say.note: 会启动 5 人审计团队并行检查并出报告。

say.text: 审计当前分支和基线的 diff,找出可利用漏洞。
say.note: 会优先分析变更,并在可行时给出 PoC。

say.text: 验证这个威胁模型,做发布前安全检查。
say.note: 会按真实可利用性评估风险并给修复建议。

howto.what_en: Claude forms a 5-member security team (3 vulnerability hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit code in parallel, verify which findings are actually exploitable, and deliver a report with severity, fixes, and residual risk.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'security-research', 'security review', or the /security-research command. Requires team mode and main session; target defaults to current repo if not given.

say_en.text: Run a security review on my code repository.
say_en.note: Starts the parallel audit team and produces a report.

say_en.text: Audit this branch's diff against its base for exploitable vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Focuses on changes and provides PoCs when possible.

say_en.text: Validate this threat model and do a pre-release security check.
say_en.note: Assesses risk by real exploitability and suggests fixes.
